decision.msg: LongText stores a plain string; AI tags/summary will sit beside it, never inside the value. Alternative: {text, tags} object — rejected, it breaks the 'one plain value' contract and required/empty checks.
Answers.js is a registry class (list/find/make) so Question can take a type id or class name; alternative was a loose map object.

Scale7 options are statics + getters (markers, input, step, skip, words), arriving through assign args, because subclass class-fields initialise after render(). One small method per marker set (numbers/faces/icons/bars).
Selected-state ink is #1a1a1a, identical to framework.css button.prim; no new colour. Range inputs set their midpoint explicitly because Chrome clamps the default to a late-set max (thumb sat at +3).

decision.msg: stage 2: layout stepper does NOT reuse ux/Wizard. Why: (1) Wizard.update() empties and rebuilds the step body on every Next/Back, which would destroy the live Answer instances and their values; the stepper builds every Question once and only toggles which is visible. (2) Wizard.js imports /app.js, so the kit would depend on the whole site and its node tests could not load it. (3) Its left rail lists step titles, wrong for 20 unnamed questions. Alternative: Wizard steps with content() re-appending stored Questions; rejected as a workaround. Quiz = stepper + a question's `correct` value + a score screen; JsonPanel is its own small class.
